1,T_LIB_OVEN,"ID_OVEN: Oven number.
ID_BATTERY: Battery number.
STA_OVEN_COKE: Indicates the oven status (charging/pushing/VALID/invalid).
COKE_MIN_TIME: Minimum coking time.
OVEN_HANDLING: Describes the handling process of the oven.
OVEN_TYPE: Indicates whether the particular oven is in level 2 schedule sequence or out of sequence.
DT_CHARGING_MOMENT: Time of charging coal into the particular oven.
DT_RELEASE_MOMENT: Time when the oven will be ready to push (based on charging moment + coke minimum time).
DT_PUSHING_MOMENT: Time when the oven was pushed last (the cycle involves pushing, charging, and then reaching the release moment).
DT_PUSHING_MOMENT_PREV: Pushing moment of that particular oven in the previous cycle.
WT_COAL: Amount of coal charged in that oven.
DOOR_AGE_COKE: Age of the coke door.
DOOR_AGE_RAM: Age of the ram door.
CD_SCHEDULABLE_OPTION: Indicates scheduling options available for the oven.
OVEN_NIS_TYPE: Type of oven NIS (Non-Intrusive System).
D_CLEANING_STATUS: Status of the cleaning process.
CARBONISATION_INDEX: Index indicating the level of carbonization.
MAX_TEMP: Maximum temperature reached.
MAX_TIME: Maximum time recorded.
COKE_BREAKAGE: Indicates occurence of Cake breakage (1 or 0), Not completely reliable flag..
OVEN_READY_STA: Status indicating whether the oven is ready.

column5: quality=exclude_nulls_and_infinite_values",T_LIB_OVEN,"This table contains rowise details of each oven from charging to pushing moment. Each ID_SEQ_COKE is a unique identifier for na new charging. and with respect to this ID_SEQ_COKE details of ID_OVEN, ID_BATTERY , charging time ,release time , and other details gets filled at the time of charging. Other columns are filled during the coking cycle of that particular oven and eventually a particula oven is ready to be pushed after it has crossed its release time. Once the oven is pushed it becomes empty and gets ready for next charging ( new id_seq_coke ). This table plays major role in report creation and other details with repect to particular pushing charging of an oven. Also it contains the histore of all those ovens differentiated by id_seq_coke. Higher id_seq_coke means latest information for that oven.
